song.title: Spirit of God move
song.lyrics:
[V1] Abba Father, here's what I cry, "Come by here, lord, Your spirit You won't deny" When I see your wrath fixing To be poured on this earth For this message that was heard, My desperate cry
[C1] Spirit of God, move Write your words in my heart Fill my whole being consume my life. Spirit of God, move An empty vessel I want to be, So that you can come, Lord and fill me.
[V2] I lift my hands, I surrender laying all on the altar I don't want to pretend but be sealed by your hand I'll take your word, and I'll hide it in my heart. Till every fiber in my being Has desperate cry
[V3] I've recognised your voice and I've understood the call Lord help me not to faint but stand and overcome Lord, I just want to please you That's all I want to do So from my soul now, I cry to You
song.presentation: v1 c1 v2 c1 v3 c1
